# ADR-3235: AWS secrets: Plaintext environment secret for Lambda 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Environment variables appear in consoles and dumps.

## Decision

Lambdas MUST NOT inject a plaintext environment secret for Lambda 3 (AWS-secrets-3).

## Consequences

Fetch secrets at runtime from Secrets Manager/SSM.
